'''Valera''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Computer/Legends|computer]] specialist who was a member of the [[Gray Griffins]], a [[Scout/Legends|scouting]] team that served the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. After the Alliance made a deal with the [[Radell Mining Corporation]], Valera and the Griffins were sent to perform some exploration work for RMC and they discovered the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Alluuvia]] in the [[Elrood sector/Legends|Elrood sector]]. However, the Grffins' [[3-Z light freighter]] [[Whisper (starship)|''Whisper'']] was attacked by [[The Scourge]], a band of pirates that operated in the region, and Valera and the other Gray Griffins were captured. The scouting team were imprisoned in The Scourge's base on the planet [[Dega]] and they became malnourished as a result of their treatment. However, they were eventually rescued by a group of Alliance agents, and Valera and her compatriots were subsequently transported to the planet [[Elrood/Legends|Elrood]] to receive medical treatment.
